statement: Question: Can G be (S, k)-modified into a connected graph H with dH (v) ≡ δ(v) (mod `) for each v ∈ V (H)?
context: `-CDME(S): Connected Degree Modulo-`-Editing(S) Instance: A graph G, integer k and a function δ : V (G) → {0, . . . , ` − 1}. Question: Can G be (S, k)-modified into a connected graph H with dH (v) ≡ δ(v) (mod `) for each v ∈ V (H)? Note that 2-CDME(S) is CDPE(S). The following theorem shows that the complexity of 3-CDME(S) may differ from 2-CDME(S). I Theorem 11. 3-CDME({ea, ed}) is NP-complete even if δ ≡ 2.
